source_text: Specific narrations, such as those in Sunan Abi Dawud attributed to Umm Atiyyah describing a form of female cutting as recommended (mustahabb), are invoked by proponents to frame FGM as a sunnah practice promoting ritual purity and restraint of sexual desire. [76]
